subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should the public WhatsApp sticker capability transport only caller-supplied sticker-ready WebP, or promise conversion of ordinary static and animated media?
rationale: Source and Baileys contracts prove native sticker transport is feasible, but conversion introduces materially different validation, codec, metadata, dependency, and failure behavior that implementation evidence cannot choose safely.

options.title: Transport Ready WebP
options.body: Expose an explicit sticker action that validates and sends compliant caller-supplied WebP through the existing helper.

options.title: Convert Source Media
options.body: Accept ordinary static and animated images and own a complete WhatsApp-compatible conversion and metadata pipeline.

recommendation.title: Transport Ready WebP
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit sticker action that validates and sends compliant caller-supplied WebP through the existing helper.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history and issue-discussion context for the WhatsApp send and media boundary.
